title: Dental hygienist assistant: rinse, clear the mouth and return both tools
instruction: Rinse the highlighted teeth, lift the rinsing tool while suction clears the mouth, then return and release both tools on their stands.
context: A familiar dental-visit procedure: rinsing and evacuation after professional tooth polishing on an inert training phantom. One arm sweeps wet crown regions while the other positions an evacuation inlet at mouth-floor water, then clears residual water and returns both tools. The physical skill is simultaneous coverage and location-dependent water removal; it does not simulate polishing or plaque removal. Societal relevance corresponds to societal relatability in the review rubric. Reconstruction and measurement synopsis: README.md.
setup: Existing dimensioned acetal dental phantom and two 75 g bent tools. Three target crowns at (235,25,37), (270,25,37), (305,25,37) mm. Mouth-floor cells centred at (235/270/305,0,31) mm, each 28x18 mm, connected by narrow gutters. Water visibly flows from the irrigator to crowns, drains into floor pools and enters the suction tip only during actual model recovery. Physical equipment and reconstruction in PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md. Original stand origins: irrigator(280,200,30), suction(280,-200,30) mm. Earlier v2 held-tool endpoint videos are historical.
scoring: Any guard failure, spill>0.30 mL, whole-trial peak mouth water>1.00 mL, final mouth water>0.50 mL, or recovery<90% supplied gives0. Otherwise0.25 per tooth with>=1.8 mL delivery and>=0.15 s wet dwell in all9 crown regions, up to0.75. Full1.0 additionally requires final mouth water<=0.05 mL; after the final pulse the irrigator tip must be above80 mm while suction remains in the declared mouth-floor region>=1 s until cleared. Both tools must then return to their original stands within10 mm XY,5 mm Z and10 degrees orientation, speed<20 mm/s, with every fingertip>65 mm from both handle references. Hold the returned-and-released endpoint1 s. Pump0.4 mL/s at16-21,24-29,32-37 s; all water and temporal checks use actual model state. PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md specifies physical measurement and uncertainty. Raw score1.0 is withheld until the continuous1 s endpoint hold completes; earlier full-quality endpoints receive0.75.
reset_notes: Fixed initial layout, seed1, zero jitter. Reset tool poses, water inventories, peak/loss/guard history, cleanup timer and cleanup-complete flag. Both tools initially sit released on their own stands; this cannot satisfy post-rinse cleanup.
fidelity: Rigid inert phantom; conservative crown-runoff and connected mouth-pool model, not CFD. Blue water display and moving droplets show state/flow, not calibrated optical appearance. No saliva, swallowing, airway, aerosols or soft tissue. Near-surface suction and crossflow laws are unvalidated; bench calibration is required. No clinical safety claim.
